activity.notes: While employed at the Swiss patent office in Bern, Einstein produced the landmark papers of his annus mirabilis in 1905. ATLAS records this sharply documented Swiss intellectual-activity year instead of conflating his later German and American careers into one polity span.

sources.title: Albert Einstein: Beamter im Patentamt 1900–1909 — ETH Library
sources.citation_text: ETH Library documents Einstein's Bern patent-office period and his major 1905 scientific papers.
